parent_objective: run one smoke-scale PPO continuation from M299 with M297 rejected-history preference auxiliary loss

public_gates: exact M297 rejected-preference no-regression before replay promotion
exact M270 no-regression before replay promotion
full replay protected-key and behavior gates only after first gates pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run medium or long PPO in M302
do not promote if exact M297 or exact M270 regresses
do not loosen M183/M170 or M267/M264 replay gates
hypothesis: Adding the M297 rejected-history preference auxiliary loss to smoke PPO from M299 will reduce M267/M264 wrong-history washout without regressing exact M270 or public replay surfaces.
success_criteria: raw PPO or a non-micro interpolation improves or retains exact M297 and exact M270 versus M299
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates pass
full public replay protected-key and behavior gates pass before promotion
failure_criteria: exact M297 or exact M270 regresses for every nonzero candidate
safe interpolation collapses to a micro-alpha
PPO is lengthened beyond smoke scale

commands.name: m302_smoke
commands.command: Run configs/ppo_m302_rejected_preference_guarded_smoke.json from m298pref_a020 for 1024 PPO steps, then exact-gate and replay-gate before any promotion.

decision_rule: M302 is rejected because raw PPO and every nonzero interpolation alpha regress exact M297 and exact M270, so replay promotion gates are not reached.
